Axiom: The `FLOW_VERSION=v1` / `READINESS=not-ready` preflight gate protects scope-spanning work — a full migration or readiness setup dwarfs a narrow request. Size the gate to the task's own blast radius before firing it: when the requested change stays inside the door's own scope (a spec paragraph, a single ticket) and never touches `tasks/` layout or a missing gate script, record the state in one line and proceed straight to the door's own work — offer migration / readiness setup to the operator as a separate next step, not inside this run. A change whose blast radius does reach `tasks/` layout, task-ID rewriting, or a missing gate script fires the gate as before, ahead of the door's own work.
